description:
Respond to a customer's maintenance request using a pre-configured Saved Reply template. 

1. Log in to FreeScout (admin@helpdesk.local / Admin123!) if not already logged in.
2. Navigate to the 'AV Service Desk' mailbox.
3. Open the conversation with subject 'Projector Maintenance Request - Conference Room B' from Rachel Torres.
4. Reply to the conversation by inserting the 'Maintenance Appointment Confirmation' saved reply template. Do not type the response manually; use the Saved Reply feature (# icon or bookmark icon in toolbar).
5. Send the reply.
